title: 沪教牛津五年级下册配套练习
sourceNote: 用户提供的12组小练习，共24题；Unit 4、10第一题的shtu分别更正为am、is；Unit 3第一题、Unit 10第二题增加限定条件消除双答案，原题原答及说明保留。
notice: 按题核对答案，不折算百分制。笔误和歧义题已在解析中注明修订原因。

papers.title: Unit 1 小练习
papers.sourceText:
1. This umbrella is ____. (mine / my)
2. —Are those crayons theirs? —Yes, ____. (they are / it is)
✅答案：1.mine 2.they are

questions.stem: This umbrella is ____.
questions.originalStem: This umbrella is ____. (mine / my)

questions.stem: —Are those crayons theirs? —Yes, ____.
questions.originalStem: —Are those crayons theirs? —Yes, ____. (they are / it is)

papers.sourceText:

✅答案：1.because 2.Why

questions.stem: —____ do you like the dining room? —Because it is bright.
questions.originalStem: —____ do you like the dining room? —Because it is bright. (Why / What)

papers.title: Unit 3 小练习
papers.sourceText:
1. I ____ (will / won’t) be tall in the future.
2. She ____ wear glasses. (won’t / don’t)
✅答案：1.will 2.won’t

questions.stem:
填入表示“将会”的词，表达肯定预测：
I ____ be tall in the future.
questions.originalStem: I ____ (will / won’t) be tall in the future.
questions.adjustment: 原题 will 与 won’t 均可构成合法句子；补充“表达肯定预测”条件，使来稿参考答案 will 唯一。

questions.stem: She ____ wear glasses.
questions.originalStem: She ____ wear glasses. (won’t / don’t)
